reviews.name: Begum Taskazan
reviews.text: I did their signature Nicaragua trip with them as a solo female traveler. I was nervous since I haven’t travelled solo before, but all guides were super welcoming, so is the other SYBers. This trip was exactly what I was looking for: social and active!

reviews.name: Sara MacKay
reviews.text:
It’s been a couple years since I went to Nicaragua with Surf Yoga Beer, and it’s still one of the best trips I’ve ever taken. It completely changed what I look for when I travel. I stopped caring about checking boxes and started chasing experiences, adventure, and the kinds of people who make you laugh until your abs hurt.

I still keep in touch with friends from that trip, and I somehow keep running into them in random corners of the world—which feels very on-brand for SYB.

If you’re on the fence because of the cost or because taking time off work feels impossible, let me save you some time: future you is already rolling their eyes. Book the trip.

The Nicaragua setup is unreal. I still dream about the breakfasts before heading out to surf, the sunset horseback rides on the beach, and evening yoga overlooking the ocean after a full day of getting salty and sunburned in the best way possible.

Surf Yoga Beer somehow attracts the kind of people who say yes to adventures, cheer each other on, and become lifelong friends after just a week together. The world feels a whole lot smaller after an SYB trip…and a whole lot more fun.

Zero regrets. Only one complaint: every vacation since has had impossibly big shoes to fill.

reviews.name: Amy Rivera
reviews.text: Just got back from the Amalfi trip and WHAT A DREAM not just bc of the beautiful places we got to see but for the people I met, true friendships were formed and our leaders Sam Nikki Carrie and Adam were just amazing always looking out for us but also vibing with us and hiping us up the hole time probably see you in Nicaragua on NYE

reviews.name: Sierra Vigna
reviews.text:
UPDATE: Travelled for a third time with SYB to Iceland and it was the best decision I ever made. My favourite thing about these trips is that I book it and don't have to think twice about itinerary or planning for a second - I just show up and SYB shows me the time of my life. Meag, Christian and Eli - the amazing leaders who show up for everyone and really are the glue that holds the whole thing together - thank you SO MUCH for all of your effort and for being incredible humans and guiding us through this unbelievable trip. I'll probably have to edit this review again in a few months because I'm not done travelling with SYB!

Just came back from my second trip with SYB - the Nicaragua trip was incredibly fun and I felt zero stress the entire time I was there. Holly, Matas and Luke were the coolest leaders and kept everything organized while also having a blast alongside our group. 10/10 recommend traveling this way - good for the soul. 🩷

reviews.name: Ryan Conley
reviews.text: SYB Nicaragua was incredible. I went in knowing only 1 person, and ended up with amazing new friends from across the country. There was never a moment that was “too much” but even if there was, there would never have been judgement for passing on one thing or another. Great for all levels and a warm, exciting environment to explore, try new things, and have an amazing time!

reviews.name: Julian Pedraza
reviews.text:
I did an extensive search for surf camps across Central America and was lucky to find SYB Nicaragua as one of the most promising options. Mantas, the owner, kindly explained how it worked and shared experiences from previous guests. That’s when I realized I was getting more than I expected—a balanced mix of surfing, wellness, and active living, surrounded by people with similar lifestyles. I was there in the middle of March.

Carri and Rob are excellent hosts and leaders. They unite the team, guide everyone, and join right in. Drawing on insights from past trips, they keep improving the experience for each new group. Their great reputation across the villas, beach, and town helps guests connect easily with locals, making everything enjoyable and stress-free. My understanding is hosts rotate for every trip.

The trip lasted six days, with two spent mainly traveling from Liberia, Costa Rica to San Juan del Sur and back. If possible, fly directly to Managua—you’ll save several hours and avoid border hassles.

We surfed three of the four active days, doing one to two sessions per day. Alongside that, we had guided yoga, training, journaling, town explorations, and visits to bars and restaurants—a well-balanced mix of activities. I won’t spoil the details, but it was amazing!

All the locals working with SYB, from drivers and chefs to surf instructors, guides and others, were friendly, helpful, and easy to connect with. Building personal bonds with them was probably the most fulfilling part. The food at the villas was incredible, you’ll wish you could take the cooks home!

My fellow solo travelers were exceptional, coming from all corners of the US. We had an ideal balance of ages, professions, and routines, and spending time together helped us form close bonds.

You know a trip was great when you don’t want to return to reality. it’s been a month, and I still wish I was there.

reviews.name: V
reviews.text:
WOW! This review is specifically for the classic Nicaragua trip. I went on my first SYB trip last month. What an incredible trip! Really appreciated how SYB takes care of basically everything after you arrive in Nicaragua.
The resort that SYB hosts at is GORGEOUS and I won't be able to do a proper job describing it, but trust me, it is insanely beautiful. I did the shared room and it was really spacious. They hired a chef for our group for the week and I am still missing their breakfasts.
Our two guides kept the atmosphere super fun, organized, and very exciting but no one forced us to participate, which I thought was really nice.
Remember to bring small bills ($1 and $5) to help tip all of the wonderful staff, drivers, and cooks! All in all a great trip.

reviews.name: Luke Harris
reviews.text: Surf camp Nicaragua was fantastic!  Rob and Carri did a great job organizing events but also changed plans to adapt specifically for our group. Great surf instructors, equipment and waves! Will definitely try and join another trip soon. If you’re on the fence just go for it!

reviews.name: Katie Bollinger
reviews.text: I had the most amazing experience with SurfYogaBeer Nicaragua! Every day was a new adventure filled with fitness, surfing, hiking, socializing and delicious food. Our group hosts were great and helped make the week so enjoyable. The other solo travelers will definitely be lifelong friends! If you are on the fence about booking a trip DO IT— you don’t regret it! This is your sign :)

reviews.name: Cole Untiedt
reviews.text: Surf Yoga Beer is the best group travel out there! Everything is handled and communicated to you ahead of time, and you are introduced to the group. My trip with them to the Philippines was a complete delight, and it was certainly an elevated experience which I could not have experienced with any other group or company. All there leaders are accomplished, and make the trip an experience you will want to come back for! 🏄🏽‍♂️

reviews.name: Adam Jubert
reviews.text: This was my first trip with SurfYogaBeer and I’m already planning my next one. Every day in Nicaragua was full of fun, adventure, and laughter: the whole group loved the morning workouts, home cooked meals, surfing, sunset yoga, and various surprises throughout the week. Major shout out to Kaia’s leadership: she made everything feel seamless and her positivity was contagious. And shout out to Brycen for taking some amazing photos while always making the group laugh! I joined the group solo and left with lifelong friends, and I can’t thank SYB enough for that.

reviews.name: Fabian Sanchez
reviews.text: I had an amazing time in SYB Nicaragua.  Everyday was full of fun activities.  The weather was amazing and the location was wonderful with spectacular views.  Jenny did a great job of leading the fun, yet challenging workouts.  Kaia and Brycen were great at organizing the activities and capturing every moment of the great memories that we made.  This was my first SYB and I was a little hesitant to book at first since I am in my late 40s.  I was pleasantly surprised to see many people of different age groups and how well everyone got along.  This trip exceeded all of my expectations and I would highly recommend any one of any age to book.

reviews.name: Joey Valentino
reviews.text:
This trip to Nicaragua with Surf Yoga Beer was unreal. I’ve always been a solo, digital-nomad type traveler, but this completely sold me on group travel. Not lying, I’ve never smiled so hard, laughed so loud, trained so hard hungover, caught so many waves, and straight up never drank this much beer in my life 🤣

I’m not a great surfer, I hate yoga, and circuit training isn’t my thing but pushing my comfort zone with people I genuinely liked made it ridiculously fun. Seeking discomfort turned into the best part of the trip. I nailed the beer part too ;-)

Huge shoutout to Kaia, our group leader. She led with fun and adventure without ever feeling bossy or “in charge.” It was more like, damn… she’s got everything handled. She partied with us, but behind the scenes she was constantly managing logistics and adapting to changes so smoothly that we barely noticed when things didn’t go exactly as planned. I notice these things cuz I’m normally the one doing that.

What impressed me most: she took thousands of photos, narrowed them down to the best 600, edited them, and delivered everything in a Dropbox within a day and a half after the trip ended. That almost never happens. The photos are one of the best parts of experiences like this, and she absolutely crushed it.

Also shoutout to Brycen for being an incredible right-hand man always moving fast, helping wherever needed, and killing it on the camera while literally being the best at making everyone feel welcomed and comfortable. Like when I first arrived this dude was so warm and welcoming I was like hell yea. Thanks bro. Brycen ur the frikkin man. U inspire me bro.

Would 100% do this again.

reviews.name: Travis Hughes
reviews.text:
I approached SYB from a pretty big place of apprehension. Never had I solo-tripped before, and never had I flown into such a far away place not even being able to speak the local language. Were the people going to be my speed? Would I be the oddball that didn’t fit into this kind of group? What the hell am I doing?

Within about 24 hours with this group in the majesty of Nicaragua, not only were those questions quelled, but the answers were far more impactful on me than I ever could’ve realized. I have lifelong friends from such vastly different walks of life than my own, simply because we were all in the same boat looking for the same thing… but not even able to describe what we were looking for.

This came down to not only the people that booked the trip with me, but our leaders, Bradford and Kaia. At one point, we asked how long they had been doing this trip together, because everything, including a few unavoidable hiccups (nobody’s fault!) were handled with such grace and attention. Surely, these two had led dozens of these together. But nope, this was Kaia’s first trip after finishing SYB’s Leadership Academy. What a testament to her, and what a testament to all of SYB’s leaders for being able to set such a high standard! I’m confident that any trip would have this high level of leadership.

I could ramble on about what these folks, leaders, place, and event means to me. My biggest advice: the more nervous you are about a trip with SYB, the more you SHOULD book it. Trust me. You’ll get more out of it than folks who have done multiple.

Thanks so much for the trip of a lifetime, everyone!

reviews.name: Ashley Casper
reviews.text:
I found SYB while searching for "solo together" group trips. I wanted to travel, but felt intimidated doing it completely alone, and thought it would be more fun with people. From the very first WhatsApp message, SYB treated me like a person, not a number. They were responsive, encouraging, and went above and beyond to help me figure out flights and packing when I signed up on short notice for the Nicaragua surf camp.

That same level of care carried through the entire trip. Arrival and the border crossing were very new experiences for me but SYB paired us with buddies and had guides helping every step of the way. Once there, the accommodations were total vacation vibes: clean rooms with ocean views, infinity pools, cozy places to lounge, early morning coffee (I love coffee) and easy access to the beach. The onsite cooking and cleaning staff were friendly and professional, and the meals were delicious with lots of variety. I compared it to having tropical Thanksgiving. Our fearless SYB leaders took the best care of us, and having professional photographers meant we got to live in the moment, which I really appreciated.

Despite it being a surf camp, I didn’t know how to surf and went in fully prepared to just enjoy the beach instead. But the instructors were patient, adapted to all levels, and my group was incredibly encouraging. Everyone in our group ended up standing up on their surf board on day one, including me, (apparently a SYB first), which became a pretty perfect metaphor for the week — I kept trying things even if they were outside my comfort zone, and got lots of support along the way.

What surprised me the most though was the sense of community. A lot of trips promise connection but you never really know whether you'll make friends that last after the trip. Somehow, between all the activities, laughs, and shared experiences, this trip created space for genuine conversations in a way I've rarely .. maybe never ... experienced, even having done a lot of meetup events in the US.

The trip was operationally everything you'd want - it was well planned, fun, beautiful, and exciting - AND it also created space for real, meaningful connections.

reviews.name: Paul Butler
reviews.text:
I had a great time on the classic SYB Nicaragua trip. The location is truly as beautiful as in the pictures, with multiple pools, great views overlooking the beach, and spectacular sunsets/sunrise from the yoga deck.

But what really made the trip were the people! I've done some other group travel before and have always found people friendly, but something about the people SYB attracts is special. Everyone was incredibly open and easy going, and by the end of the trip it felt like we had known each other for years.

To top it off, Jenny, Kaia, and Brycen were a well-balanced group of leaders who kept the workouts hard and kept the group on track. When sailing was cancelled due to high winds, the team switched to plan B by renting us all quads which ended up being my favorite day.

reviews.name: Suzanne Cohen
reviews.text:
One of the best trips I never expected.
Kaia and Brycen were outstanding…taking charge with ease and pivoting w grace.

So many amazing people ..silliness …and unexpected enlightenment.

Well done SYB…thank you so much for an incredible trip to Nicaragua!

I’ll be coming back..

reviews.name: Lindsey Baumann
reviews.text: My husband and I went on the Nicaragua NYE trip and had an absolute blast. I knew when signing up that SYB guests are typically single travelers so I was a little unsure on how we would be received overall by the group. We're in our mid 30s, with no kids and running out of fellow childless friends to travel with - IYKYK. Everyone was SO NICE and we made friends right away and had an absolute blast. You could pack in your days with non stop activities or take it slow and chill in the pool. It was the perfect mix of adventure and relaxation. The waves in Nica are a dream for beginner surfers. The amazing people and leaders in our group were the absolute highlight of our travels and something you just don't get when traveling alone or as a couple. We will definitely be booking more SYB trips in the future - hopefully a ski trip!

reviews.name: Miles P. DeBole
reviews.text:
Surf Yoga Beer is a soul recalibration, disguised as a really good time. Lean in with me here for a minute:

I went on their January 2026 Nicaragua adventure.  This is the kind of excursion that changes you if you let it.

You wake up smiling. You go to bed smiling.
Then you hit 🔂

Everything hums:

•The place: grounding, wild, and rooted in the spirit of Nicaragua

•The community: open, curious, safe, welcoming, and kind

•The food: nourishing, abundant, and made with love

•The views: the kind that quiet your nervous system

•The itinerary: paced, well thought through, organized, and they know how to execute

•The surf: accessible no matter your level, playful, humbling, and pure joy

•The coffee: elite-tier

•The yoga: soulful, steady, living (again no matter your level)

•The vibes: dialed. always. somehow. You’ll feel this more than you can understand it

But the real magic? The leadership.

Kaia and Bradford are one of those rare combinations that make you glad you’re alive. They were our SYB guides.

They are endlessly fun, deeply loving, and completely attuned to energy — not just noticing it, but guiding it. They know when to turn the volume up, when to soften the room, when to let things unfold, and when to gently steer the ship. That kind of awareness isn’t taught. It’s embodied.

And here’s the thing that makes it unstoppable: They’re also consummate operators.

Everything just… FITS. Seamlessly. Effortlessly. Quietly. You feel held without ever feeling managed. Supported without being smothered. Free without chaos. That balance is rare — and it’s intentional.

Their warmth carries you exactly where you need to be — sometimes literally, always energetically.

They lead with joy, precision, integrity, and an unshakable commitment to their values. When belief and action are that aligned, it’s magnetic.

Arrived solo. Left with lifelong friends. Sarah, Ash, T3, Danny D, thank you for completing something in me I didn’t know I needed: a few crabs in a bucket 🦀🫠

Can only pray the spirit of Nica follows me home — gently but permanently: I know I’ll never be the same.

SO! If you’re still reading this, please, do yourself a favor.

“Buy the damn concert tickets!!” 🌊✨🍻

Mad love!
Miles

Ps shout out to the newest member of the SYB leadership crew: Mr. Brycen Steel!!
Aka MGK was on a training course during our trip and stuck it out with heart and maturity despite turning his ankle!! Can’t wait to watch you evolve, grow and master your craft through the journey SYB will provide my dude!! You’re a natural 💟

reviews.name: Ely Goldberg
reviews.text:
I have now been on two incredible Surf Yoga Beer trips and all I can say is wow! Just spent a week in Belize in December, and I’m still riding the high from it and have already booked my next trip. I’ve traveled a lot, but these trips feel different in the best way; more connected, more intentional, and honestly more fun than I expected. Both Belize and my NYE last year in Nicaragua were both 10/10!!

What stood out most wasn’t just the beautiful beaches or the balance of planned activities, but the people. On both trips the group energy was unreal. Everyone showed up open, supportive, and ready to make the most of every moment. By the end of the week, it felt like we’d known each other forever.

The leaders also deserve a huge shoutout, Mantas, Steph, Courtney, Sam, Eli, Duncan, Allison, Sav, Shriner and Matas and so many more across both trips. They set the tone from day one: warm, organized, and genuinely invested in making sure every single person had an amazing experience. They’re the kind of people who make you want to show up as your best self.

Every day had its own magic, whether it was sunrise workouts, exploring Caye Caulker, standing up on a surfboard for the first time ever, or laughing over dinner after a full day of adventure. And, of course, the big highlight each trip were the multiple boat days!!

If you’re thinking about booking a Surf Yoga Beer trip, just do it. The destinations are incredible, but it’s the community and the leadership that make it unforgettable. I left feeling inspired, recharged, and genuinely grateful for all the people I met.

reviews.name: Mitchell Nunis
reviews.text:
Believe the hype, Surf Yoga Beer is absolutely the real deal.

I just returned from their Nicaraguan NYE tour and it's genuinely one of my favourite weeks of my life. As the only Australian in the group, I walked in wondering if I'd find my people. I did, instantly. From the moment I arrived, I felt welcomed and genuinely connected; not just to the team, but to everyone around me.

What makes SYB so special is the heart behind it. The leadership is genuinely enthusiastic about creating moments that matter, and that energy is infectious. They took 50 strangers and somehow turned us into people who've shared something truly profound together. The activities (disco night, karaoke, the boat party, the NYE white party) weren't just fun; they became the backdrop for real human connection.

And then there are the little touches that make all the difference. Having two professional photographers meant we could actually be present, actually live in the moment without our phones getting in the way. We got to just be there together, and they captured it all so we could relive it later.

I've walked away with friendships from this trip that feel like they'll genuinely last. There was laughter, there were tears, there was joy, and plenty of dancing. But mostly, there was this feeling of being seen, welcomed, and part of something bigger than myself.

If you're on the fence, jump in. I'm already planning my next trip.

reviews.name: Susie McKeon
reviews.text:
Don’t think. Just book.

I booked the NYE Nicaragua trip, and it quite possibly changed my life. From the moment you arrive on day one, everything is planned for you 100%. All you have to do is show up, literally and metaphorically. The workouts are fun and intense but totally doable for a generally active person, and somehow everyone on the trip immediately feels like a future lifelong friend.

Yes, it can get a little “woo woo” at times, but if you lean into the spirituality, you’ll get exactly what you’re meant to get out of it. The trip leaders are incredibly fun, warm, and genuinely invested in making sure you have the best experience possible. Fair warning: it’s an introvert’s worst nightmare - nonstop from 7 a.m. until midnight and beyond - but again… LEAN IN.

Highly, highly recommend. Already saving up for my next trip.

reviews.name: James Breen
reviews.text:
If you value experiences and connection over basic luxury in your travels, Surf Yoga Beer could be for you. I had an incredible time in Nicaragua over New Years with a good combination of surfing, fitness, thoughtful reflection, and social activities. The instructors were all great people who go above and beyond to make sure everyone is having fun.

If you’re on the fence, choose courage before comfort and take the leap. Everyone’s different, but would be surprised if you don’t come back with gratitude for an unforgettable  adventure.

reviews.name: Lukas
reviews.text:
This New Year’s trip with SYB in Nicaragua was truly something special. Every day was thoughtfully planned with a variety of options that catered to everyone’s different wants and needs. Even with a huge group of 52 people, the experience felt incredibly personal. We were all engaged, connected, and able to build friendships.

The week itself was nothing short of amazing with relaxation on the beach, partying on boats, cruising through town, and fully immersing ourselves in the beauty and culture of Nicaragua. Everyone came with intention - celebrate life, embrace new experiences, and share meaningful moments with new friends along the way.

From what started as a spontaneous SYB run on Venice Beach, California and then ending up at a full scale group adventure in Nicaragua, this trip is truly one for the books and I can’t think of a better way to reconnect with what life has to offer than by taking a journey like this.

reviews.name: Stephanie Skolnik
reviews.text:
There truly aren’t enough words to describe how incredible my experience in Nicaragua was! If you’re even slightly hesitant about going on a trip with strangers—just dive in. I promise you won’t regret it.

From day one, the energy is unmatched. Everyone is incredibly kind, welcoming, and brings the best vibes — it honestly feels effortless to connect. It’s kind of wild that you can go on a one-week trip and leave with friends for a lifetime. I had such an amazing time that I literally booked another SYB trip mid-trip (yes, really)!

Thank you, SYB, for the epic memories, amazing movement, and nonstop laughs. Already counting down to the next one!

reviews.name: HIROKI
reviews.text:
I jumped on the SYB NYE trip to Nicaragua, (my first SYB trip ever), and wow, it was nothing like a normal vacation!

Every day was workouts, surfing, and parties with 50 super high energy members. The leaders, especially Mantas, were always checking in and making sure we were vibing, which made the whole thing feel so easy and welcoming.

It was my first time in Nicaragua too, and honestly everything went smooth. No weird moments, no stress and just good times… except for getting several mosquitoes bites.

Already hyped for the next one!

reviews.name: Andrew Vaitkevicius
reviews.text: Don’t think, just do! Immaculate vibes in Nicaragua. I did not expect to meet so many awesome and interesting people. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Jacklyn Adams
reviews.text:
Second SYB trip in the books and Nicaragua was a TIME! Also so gorgeous! If you’re a sunset lover like me you’ll fall in love.

Quick recap of the itinerary: ATV’d (everywhere), rode horseback at sunrise, went deep-sea fishing, explored a local town, hit a karaoke bar, surfed daily, and even summited a shark-fin-shaped rock (see pics!)

I think what I love about Surf Yoga Beer is how easy they make everything. You seriously just show up and enjoy. The itinerary is thoughtful and the vibes are immaculate. It’s very clear they’ve done this many times!

I’m already booked for my next SYB adventure in Kenya with friends I met on a previous trip (check out Amalfi too 😉). If you want unforgettable memories and real connections, this is it. Don’t think, just do!

reviews.name: Erand Saraci
reviews.text: This was my first SYB trip and it was in Nicaragua. Traveling with people you never met or you don’t know can be a bit awkward but from the airport pickup it never felt that way. Everyone was awesome from the people that came from various parts of the world to the leaders Mantas, Eli, Kaia, Nikki, Brianna, Holly. It was a great experience that definitely recommend to everyone that is hesitating and will probably book another trip in 2026. The trip was filled with tough but fulfilling workouts (Mantas will push you to the limit), great sunset yoga sessions, amazing breakfasts and dinners, surfing lessons for all levels and many other activities.

reviews.name: Eric M
reviews.text: Epic trip. Highly recommend it.  I just returned from the Nicaragua trip.  I’m so excited & booked my next trip with them next year!   If you are looking at it, don’t think too much, just book it!

reviews.name: Jack Wang
reviews.text:
​I had a very memorable "Primal" week in Nicaragua with Surf Yoga Beer. The itinerary delivered exactly what it promised: butt-kicking workouts, a clean diet, and non-stop adventure. The leaders were high-energy and personable, creating an environment where it was easy to connect with other like-minded travelers.

​It’s rare to find a trip that balances activities, fitness, and space to disconnect and recharge, but SYB nailed it!

Would highly recommend if you are looking to meet cool people over adventures, workouts, and beers!

reviews.name: Andrew Smith
reviews.text:
SYB Nicaragua was my first ever solo trip so I was a little anxious at first, but the entire way - from speaking with Mantas before booking, to meeting the shuttles in Liberia, to the entire week at the villas - I felt like I was supported in taking risks and becoming the best version of myself.

The trip was extremely well run and you really do leave with a group of friends that feel like family. Couldn't recommend them more.

reviews.name: Liat Abramove
reviews.text:
Probably one of the best experiences of my life. First trip was in Japan and knew I had to book another trip. Just coming off my second trip in Nicaragua. Such awesome vibes- workouts, great food and surfing.
Made some new friends and got some awesome pictures. Ive done some research with other companies and nothing is as legit as SYB. Can’t wait to head to Egypt in the spring!

reviews.name: Katie Hall
reviews.text: I couldn’t imagine another trip topping SYB Kenya ‘24, but SYB Nica was truly incredible. Both times I’ve left with new friends that feel more like family. These trips are a perfect mix of pushing yourself, seeing new things, moments of reflection, and what felt like endless laughter. The trip leaders (Mantas, Steph, Eli, Erin and Rob) have all been top notch. As they’d say - don’t think, just do 🙂

reviews.name: Ry Al
reviews.text: SYB Nicaragua was a life changing experience. Traveling solo, then leaving with a family. From sunrise to sunset, the leaders build a lifestyle routine for you that is stress-free, competitive and all fun. Build yourself up, choose SYB for real.

reviews.name: Emma Butler
reviews.text: I had the most amazing experience with Surf Yoga Beer in Nicaragua! It truly exceeded all my expectations! From surfing lessons and yoga sessions to horseback riding and boat day, every activity was well-organized and so much fun! We stayed in a stunning villa, enjoyed delicious food, and formed meaningful connections with everyone in the group. It was such a freeing and joyful experience, I felt completely immersed in the moment the entire time I was there. Highly recommend this adventure to anyone looking for a blend of fitness, fun, and unforgettable experiences!

reviews.name: Lindsay Parham (Student Assistance)
reviews.text: I had the absolute best time in Nicaragua with Surf Yoga Beer!This trip was the perfect combination of adventure, fun, friendship and relaxation. The views from the villas were breathtaking and the memories endless. This was the experience I didn’t know I needed but am so thankful for. Big thanks to Eli, Erin and Rob for an unforgettable time! Can’t wait for the next trip!

reviews.name: Allie Mansour
reviews.text:
Where do I even begin, from the moment I stepped into the shuttle at the airport in Nicaragua with 5 other strangers on route to our Villas for an epic 6 day trip I knew there was something special happening in that moment. There motto in DTJD(Don’t Think Just Do). The best part is you don’t have to plan anything just show up, drop your bags in your room and leave all your worries behind. If you hate fun, real life connection, reflections and did I say FUN coz it never stops then don’t go, otherwise show up and live in the best moments. Thanks to some of these leaders Rob/Eli for injecting more energy into the group, Kaia for the amazing pics which everytime I look at brings back the best memories, and for my yoga instructor Nikki who introduced me to yoga for the first time in my life. Mantas you created something that leaves everyone with lifetime memories, thank you to everyone who was there that made this experience amazing, can’t wait to do another SYB trip in the future.
Ps shout out to Dennis out shuttle driver too

reviews.name: Quentin Miller
reviews.text: It’s difficult to sum up just how incredibly awesome my SurfYogaBeer Nicaragua trip experience was- Ask anyone who has been on one you and you’ll get a similar response (IYKYK). Our crew consisted of a balanced/diverse ratio of great humans (All came solo). We started off as strangers and left as a tight knit group in just 5 action packed days. Together we did morning workouts, enjoyed delicious meals, surfed, got our yoga on, hit the pool, had some really fun themed parties (wig/white), sailed on a catamaran (definitely my highlight), hit town, and made some life changing memories. You won’t regret booking a trip so “don’t think just do” and experience the magic of SurfYogaBeer for yourself. You’ll be glad you did! 🤙🏼

reviews.name: Emily Savage
reviews.text: SYB Nicaragua was hands down one of the best, most memorable experiences I’ve ever had. Stunning villa, incredible location, delicious food, savage (but super fun) workouts and truly wonderful people. The days were packed full of activities, the leaders were fantastic and the energy in the group was 10/10. If you’re thinking about booking a trip - do it - you won’t regret it. Big love SYB family 🫶
